github-enterprise-server-pat.name: GitHub Enterprise Server (PAT auth)
github-enterprise-server-pat.description: Connect a GitHub Enterprise Server installation using a personal access token, for environments where the GitHub App flow isn't available.

heavy-review.name: Heavy review (deeper pass)
heavy-review.description: An opt-in deeper review that re-runs the finder multiple times to surface more real bugs, for the changes where catching everything matters more than speed.

kodus-trace-review-context.name: Kodus Trace review context
kodus-trace-review-context.description: Use sanitized decisions distilled from local coding-agent sessions as repository-scoped context for Kody code reviews.
